notes: Story of the World V.2, ch. 25 section 'A New Way of Living', printed pp. 231-234 (PDF 246-249), stop before 'Henry V and the Battle of Agincourt'. Text layer drops capitals and mixes in a running header, a map title and a footnote, so readings are transcribed. Chapter 25 test (printed pp. 95-97, PDF 98-100) covers the whole chapter: items 10-13 and 17-19 belong to this section; 1-9 and 14-16 to 'The Plague'. Key on SOTW2_Tests PDF p. 174. A good lesson explains urbanization, why wages rose and the feudal system weakened, the shorter apprenticeships and the returning forests in the reading's own terms.
